doc_friction.issue: A stop hook demands untracked files be committed while a background eval is still writing its output into the tree; had to add the in-progress jsonl to .git/info/exclude until the run ended. Eval scripts could write to the scratchpad and copy in at the end.

deviations.why: The pre-registered rule picked a flat 6 s; a flat 6 s would let a caller with a short budget (e.g. 3 s) wait 6 s extra, which was not tested.
deviations.did: Default is 30% of the budget capped at 6 s, which equals the tested 6 s at the 20 s big-week default.
deviations.result: Identical behaviour on every tested build; short budgets are not worse than before by more than 30% of themselves (unmeasured, stated in the README).

writeups: ventures/shift-roster-builder/README.md (The pay floor's reserve, sized from the full solve)
notes: Flagship row 4 (shift-roster-builder), item: the warm pay floor's reserve size. Pre-registered paired design (uncapped vs off per week) scores every reserve from one pair of builds. 48 fresh weeks: 6 s finishes 19/19 tries vs 13 at 1.5 s for +0.25 s mean build. Confirmation with the new default on the 6 affected weeks: 5 finished; seed 9 skipped because buildRoster's !over() gate skips the pay floor once the budget is spent (scoreFloorPlan's budget-spent 'reserve alone' mode is never reached; next item). Verification: run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder ok (706 tests, 314 s); venture-preflight clean; post front matter/links/similarity clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an OR engineer designing, running and writing up a pre-registered timing experiment plus a default change

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
